description: Main React component file for the notes application, responsible for orchestrating state management, theming, note selection, and rendering child components including Navbar, Layout, NoteList, and NoteEditor.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React functional component for the notes application, managing state, effects, and rendering child components.

methods.name: handleNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new untitled note and sets it as the selected note.

methods.name: handleSaveNote
methods.description: Saves changes to the currently selected note.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note after user confirmation.
